clis.title: CLIs
clis.description: command-line tools for Merchant Center operations or product-feed preparation.

entries.name: almoretti/gmc-cli
entries.description: Manages Merchant API v1 accounts, products, data sources, reports, and promotions through a Python CLI with JSON output and dry-run support.

entries.name: yasserstudio/gmc
entries.description: Manages Merchant API accounts and products, validates feeds, and runs setup and migration diagnostics through a TypeScript CLI. Includes an [embedded MCP server](docs/mcps/gmc.md) with a complete tool reference.

entries.name: BurhanBeigh/merchant-feed-builder
entries.description: Generates local Google Merchant Center XML or TSV feeds from Shopify catalog data through a Python CLI with product-field validation. Produces feed files for submission rather than uploading them to Merchant Center.

sdks.title: SDKs
sdks.description: official client-library entries: seven language-specific Merchant API library families and the experimental alpha distribution. Each language family contains separate packages for Merchant sub-APIs.
